in_sanskrit.name: वासव
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Basav is derived from the Sanskrit word 'vasu', meaning 'dwelling' or 'abode'. The suffix '-vas' in the name indicates 'lord of'. Thus, Basav can be translated to 'lord of all'. In Hindu mythology, Lord Indra is also known as 'Vasav', the lord of all gods.
